integrity: The proof is analytic; the exact-rational finite-state checker is a supplement rather than an infinite certificate. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite edge-environment process conditioned on unanimous strategies and homogeneous edge-environment initialization; no general mixed-strategy or fixation statement. At high per-edge switching rates, ordering flips for even observation times on four/five vertices only. Independently unverified historical priority.
title: A sharp six-vertex cutoff for transient environmental-variance ordering on trees
